text:
Ivy Chen: Hi all 496 - planning to take 8 weeks parental leave starting in ~9 weeks. Two quick, slightly scary Qs: (1) If I change my federal/state withholding now (W-4/W-4V) to account for reduced paycheck during leave, can we keep top-up calculations consistent? (2) Is the adoption stipend taxable and reported differently than the regular childcare stipend?

Tanya (People Ops): Congrats Ivy! :tada: Short answers: (1) You can update your W-4 anytime, but payroll/top-up calculations use your reported earnings during each pay period. If you change withholding pre-leave, it affects net pay and tax withholding but not the gross-top-up calculation (top-up is based on gross pay replacement policy). If you want the top-up to assume a different gross, please note that in your leave request and we'll coordinate with comp/payroll.

Tanya (People Ops): (2) Adoption stipend vs childcare stipend: adoption assistance is taxable in most cases at Redwood (we code it as "Adoption Assistance" on your W-2 box 1 unless it qualifies under IRC exceptions). Childcare stipend is reported as taxable income too unless it's a qualified dependent care FSAs/benefits. We'll provide exact tax coding in the confirmation email.

Ivy Chen: OK thanks. So if I tweak W-4 now to lower withholding and then later the top-up comes in as a gross retro pay, I might owe taxes later?

Tanya (People Ops): Correct - changing W-4 only changes withholding, not actual tax liability. Retro gross payments (top-up, retro adjustments, stipends) will be taxed in the period they are paid. Finance can do supplemental withholding if you'd like to withhold more on retro payments; request that when we send the payroll estimate.

Marcus (Manager): For coverage: Ivy, do you want a 2-week overlap for handoff? I can post a 1-paragraph note once you paste it. Also need to confirm contractor laptop shipping for 10 weeks.

Ivy Chen: 2-week overlap preferred. I'll draft the handoff. For the contractor laptop: yes please, ship to NYC office and we'll use local pickup.

payroll-bot: Payroll ticket opened: PL-TAX-2026-901. Payroll will send a breakdown of expected tax withholding for projected leave/top-up within 2 business days. Include employee ID in replies.

Tanya (People Ops): A few operational next steps for Ivy: (a) file the parental leave form (DocuSign) and check "tax coordination" if you plan to change W-4, (b) attach any adoption paperwork when available for stipend coding, (c) if you want supplemental withholding on retro top-up, reply to payroll ticket with amount/percentage.

Ivy Chen: Filing the DocuSign now. Employee ID 50122. Also adoption docs: planning a private adoption, placement expected 4-6 months after birth; will upload when I have agency letter.

Tanya (People Ops): Thanks. We'll flag the file as "adoption pending" so benefits coding waits for the placement docs. Also we'll reserve lactation room post-return and mark 2-week overlap in the calendar.

Ivy Chen: Appreciate it. One last tiny Q: will the adoption stipend be paid as a lump sum or installments?

Tanya (People Ops): Typically lump sum after submission of qualifying receipts and final paperwork, but can be split if you request installments (we'll coordinate with finance). We'll include payment method in the payroll estimate.

Marcus (Manager): Handoff draft for Ivy (copy/paste):
```
Hi team,
Ivy will be on parental leave from START_DATE to END_DATE. Primary contact: Marcus (marcus@redwood.com). Contractor NAME will cover day-to-day and pick up the laptop at NYC office. Ivy will do a 2-week overlap for knowledge transfer. See runbooks: <link>. For payroll/tax questions, contact Tanya in People Ops.
Thanks.
```

Ivy Chen: Perfect, posting now. Thank you all :heart:
